The '''Legislature''' was the ruling body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bundim]]. After the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] gained influence on the world, the Legislature tried to erase [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] influences from Bundim in secret. The result led to the [[Subjugation of Bundim|Imperial crackdown]] on the planet.
